userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 SeatReserve 的初级工程师。每轮只推进一个目标，可以询问职责、接口、状态、数据流和验证证据，但绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、锁算法、Debug 原因或修复提示。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers delivery and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件，给出分阶段计划、主要风险和验证方式。

scenes.title: Ownership
scenes.objective: Explain module and process ownership.
scenes.advanceGate: Authorities and boundaries are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 Inventory、Pricing、Hold、Order、Payment、Worker、dispatcher 和 UI 的职责与依赖。

scenes.title: Seat ownership flow
scenes.objective: Explain successful hold and atomic rejection flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Seat authority and forbidden partial state are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释多座位 Hold 成功和其中一席冲突时整组拒绝的完整状态与数据流。

scenes.title: Payment flow
scenes.objective: Explain success, unknown outcome, expiry, and reconcile races.
scenes.advanceGate: Payment and seat fences are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释支付成功、Provider 响应丢失及其与 Hold 过期竞争的完整数据流。

scenes.title: Contracts
scenes.objective: Author API and state contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: Errors, identities, work, and events are complete.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、状态、错误、幂等、Work、Event 和 snapshot 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Test strategy
scenes.objective: Define realistic verification layers.
scenes.advanceGate: Tests independently prove ownership and recovery.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、PostgreSQL Integration、Chromium、Concurrency、Recovery 和 Performance 分别验证什么。

scenes.title: Skeleton
scenes.objective: Build runnable production skeleton.
scenes.advanceGate: All roles boot and stop.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 API、React、PostgreSQL、Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架并 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.objective: Implement atomic persistence bootstrap.
scenes.advanceGate: Replay and invalid references are atomic.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，验证合法导入、重放、冲突、跨租户引用和整批回滚。

scenes.title: Inventory
scenes.objective: Implement venue, event, zone, and immutable seats.
scenes.advanceGate: Layout freezes at ON_SALE.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Venue、Event、Zone、Seat、ON_SALE 和 layout 不可变性并验证。

scenes.title: Pricing
scenes.objective: Implement effective immutable price versions.
scenes.advanceGate: Activation and hold freeze serialize.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Zone PriceVersion、非重叠生效、激活和价格冻结边界。

scenes.title: Atomic holds
scenes.objective: Implement all-or-nothing multi-seat holds.
scenes.advanceGate: Every requested seat has one owner or none.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 1..12 座位原子 Hold、冻结总价、冲突明细和 availability。

scenes.title: Expiry and cancellation
scenes.objective: Implement database-time expiry and release fences.
scenes.advanceGate: Stale workers cannot release live ownership.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成数据库时间 expiry、取消、Worker lease、fenced release 和恢复验证。

scenes.title: Checkout
scenes.objective: Implement frozen Hold to Order conversion.
scenes.advanceGate: One Hold creates one Order and PaymentIntent.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 checkout、Order、OrderSeat、PaymentIntent 和冻结金额守恒。

scenes.title: Payment uncertainty
scenes.objective: Implement UNKNOWN, receipt, and reconcile.
scenes.advanceGate: Unknown result never duplicates charge or releases early.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成稳定 Provider identity、UNKNOWN grace、重复乱序 receipt、reconcile 和结果冲突。

scenes.title: Contention and replay
scenes.objective: Prove multi-process ownership and durable idempotency.
scenes.advanceGate: Hot-seat and lost-response races converge.
scenes.safeMessage: 请验证双 API 抢同一座位、响应丢失、API 重启、并发 replay 和语义冲突。

scenes.title: Events and recovery
scenes.objective: Implement transactional events and crash recovery.
scenes.advanceGate: Worker and dispatcher failure preserve one effect.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成事务性 Event、aggregate 顺序、Worker SIGKILL 和 dispatcher 未知 ACK 恢复。

scenes.title: Booking UI
scenes.objective: Complete the real booking and operations UI.
scenes.advanceGate: Visible workflows cover V1.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Event/Zone/Seat、价格、availability、多座 Hold、倒计时、checkout、UNKNOWN 和 Order UI。

scenes.title: V1 tests and review
scenes.objective: Run real browser, races, crashes, and findings-first review.
scenes.advanceGate: No unresolved V1 finding remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行真实 PostgreSQL、production Chromium、双 API/双 Worker、Barrier SIGKILL、租户隔离并做 V1 Review。

scenes.title: Manager change
scenes.objective: Publish contiguous-seat waitlist and offers.
scenes.advanceGate: Impact plan is complete before edits.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Ticketing Manager】新增 WaitlistEntry 和 SeatOffer。本消息是完整公开合同。Entry 创建时冻结 seatCount 1..8、排序去重 allowedZoneIds、每座 unitAmountMinor+feeMinor 上限 maxUnitTotalMinor，以及未来且最长 30 天的 expiresAt；WAITLIST_MATCH Work.aggregateId=waitlistEntryId，按 createdAt,waitlistEntryId 处理 WAITING Entry。候选座位必须同 Event、同 Zone、同 row 且 number 严格连续，多组时按 zoneId,row,首号升序；价格超限或集合不足时保持 WAITING，不产生部分 Offer。Offer 在一个事务中占有全部座位、冻结每席 ACTIVE PriceVersion 和金额，并用数据库时间设置 expiresAt=createdAt+120 seconds；OFFER_EXPIRY Work.aggregateId=seatOfferId。每个 Entry 最多一个 ACTIVE Offer，每个 Seat 在 Hold、Order、Offer 中最多一个 live owner。accept 仅在未过期 ACTIVE Offer 上成功，原子创建 TTL 300 秒的正常 HELD SeatHold，沿用冻结价格并将 Entry 置 FULFILLED；decline 将 Entry/Offer 置 DECLINED 并释放座位；expiry 将 Offer 置 EXPIRED，未过期 Entry 恢复 WAITING；cancel 将 WAITING/OFFERED Entry 置 CANCELLED 并释放 ACTIVE Offer。旧 lease 不得越过 Entry cancel、Offer terminal 或 expiry fence。WaitlistEntry = {waitlistEntryId:uuid,tenantId:uuid,eventId:uuid,customerRef:string,seatCount:int,allowedZoneIds:[uuid],maxUnitTotalMinor:int,expiresAt:timestamp,state:WAITING|OFFERED|FULFILLED|DECLINED|CANCELLED|EXPIRED,createdAt:timestamp,cancelledAt:timestamp|null}。SeatOffer = {seatOfferId:uuid,waitlistEntryId:uuid,eventId:uuid,state:ACTIVE|ACCEPTED|DECLINED|EXPIRED,items:[{seatId:uuid,priceVersionId:uuid,unitAmountMinor:int,feeMinor:int}],totalMinor:int,currency:string,expiresAt:timestamp,createdAt:timestamp,holdId:uuid|null,terminalAt:timestamp|null}。公开接口：POST /api/v1/waitlist-entries，body {tenantId,eventId,customerRef,seatCount,allowedZoneIds,maxUnitTotalMinor,expiresAt}，返回 201 WaitlistEntry；POST /api/v1/waitlist-entries/:entryId/cancel，body {}，返回 200 WaitlistEntry；GET /api/v1/seat-offers/:offerId，返回 200 SeatOffer；POST /api/v1/seat-offers/:offerId/accept，body {}，返回 201 {offer:SeatOffer,hold:SeatHold}；POST /api/v1/seat-offers/:offerId/decline，body {}，返回 200 SeatOffer。所有 mutation 继承 V1 Idempotency-Key、未知字段拒绝和稳定错误 envelope。新增穷举错误：409 WAITLIST_ENTRY_TERMINAL、409 SEAT_OFFER_TERMINAL、409 SEAT_OFFER_EXPIRED、409 SEAT_OFFER_OWNERSHIP_CHANGED、400 WAITLIST_INVALID、400 INVALID_REQUEST；缺失 ID 为 404 NOT_FOUND。UI 提供候补创建/取消、Offer 倒计时、冻结价格、接受和拒绝。迁移保留 V1 Seat、Hold、Order、Payment、saved replay、pending Work 和 Event；并发释放、匹配、取消、接受、拒绝和 Worker SIGKILL 不得重复 Offer 或超卖。本轮只做影响分析和分阶段计划，不要编码。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 Manager 变更的 schema、API、Worker、迁移、并发、UI 和测试影响，不要编码。

scenes.title: Manager migration
scenes.objective: Implement compatible schema migration.
scenes.advanceGate: V1 ownership and replay survive.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，验证 V1 Seat、Price、Hold、Order、Payment、replay、Work 和 Event 不变。

scenes.title: Waitlist matching
scenes.objective: Implement fair contiguous matching and fenced offers.
scenes.advanceGate: Matching order and ownership are unique.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 Waitlist、连续座位匹配、SeatOffer、价格上限、过期/取消和 Worker 恢复。

scenes.title: Offer acceptance and UI
scenes.objective: Complete accept/decline flows and realistic tests.
scenes.advanceGate: Offer races and browser flow pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Offer 接受/拒绝、转正常 Hold、完整 UI、Integration、Chromium、Concurrency 和 Recovery 测试。

scenes.title: Performance
scenes.objective: Run all fixed sustained scenarios.
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and post-load invariants pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行三条正式压力场景，报告真实吞吐、延迟、恢复时间及负载后座位/金额/支付不变量。

scenes.title: Full regression
scenes.objective: Run aggregate regression and security review.
scenes.advanceGate: All gates and isolation checks pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行完整非性能 gate，复核租户隔离、Event 顺序、Work 排空、无超卖且无支付或私有信息泄漏。

scenes.title: Final review
scenes.objective: Complete findings-first review and handoff.
scenes.advanceGate: Handoff is accurate and evidence-backed.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复有依据的问题，并给出准确交付证据、风险和未运行项。
